summary: Diff adds a Motoko backend actor with order creation/status update logic plus a React frontend scaffold with routing, Internet Identity gating components, admin gating, a persistent roleplay disclaimer banner, an ID card preview (with scan-line effect + watermark), photo upload/crop components, state list constants, and React Query hooks/query keys. Some acceptance-criteria-specific behaviors are not verifiable from the provided diff summary due to truncation/omitted files; one reduced-motion requirement is not evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Scan-line animation can be paused/disabled automatically for reduced-motion preferences (if supported).
missing_requirements.reason: The ID card preview includes a scan-line overlay, but there is no evidence of prefers-reduced-motion handling or an alternate non-animated mode in the shown component/CSS.

hallucinated_features.description: Footer branding/link to caffeine.ai and related icon/heart attribution
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not request or mention adding third-party platform branding/attribution links in the app UI.
